morning.text: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ
morning.meaningEn: We have entered a new morning and with it all dominion belongs to Allah. Praise be to Allah; there is no god but Allah alone, without partner.

morning.text: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ لَكَ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي
morning.meaningEn: O Allah, You are my Lord; there is no god but You. You created me and I am Your servant. I acknowledge Your favour upon me and I confess my sin — forgive me.

virtue.en: The foremost of supplications for forgiveness

morning.text: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
morning.meaningEn: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in heaven can cause harm; He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.

morning.text: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا، وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ نَبِيًّا
morning.meaningEn: I am content with Allah as my Lord, with Islam as my religion, and with Muhammad as my prophet.
Glory be to Allah, and praise be to Him.

morning.text: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
morning.meaningEn: There is no god but Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His the praise, and He is able to do all things.

evening.text: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ
evening.meaningEn: We have entered a new evening and with it all dominion belongs to Allah. Praise be to Allah; there is no god but Allah alone, without partner.

evening.text: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
evening.meaningEn: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.

virtue.ar: من قالها حين يمسي لم تضره حُمَة تلك الليلة
virtue.en: Whoever says it at nightfall is protected from harm that night

evening.text: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
evening.meaningEn: O Allah, by You we enter the evening and by You the morning; by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the return.
Glory be to Allah, and praise be to Him.

sleep.meaningEn: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.

sleep.text: اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَجْمَعُ عِبَادَكَ
sleep.meaningEn: O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the day You gather Your servants.

virtue.ar: تسبيح فاطمة رضي الله عنها قبل النوم
virtue.en: The tasbih taught to Fatimah before sleep

wake.text: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
wake.meaningEn: Praise be to Allah who gave us life after death, and to Him is the resurrection.

wake.text: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي رَدَّ عَلَيَّ رُوحِي وَعَافَانِي فِي جَسَدِي وَأَذِنَ لِي بِذِكْرِهِ
wake.meaningEn: Praise be to Allah who returned my soul to me, gave health to my body, and allowed me to remember Him.

after_prayer.text: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ، تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ
after_prayer.meaningEn: O Allah, You are Peace and from You comes peace. Blessed are You, Possessor of majesty and honour.

misc.text: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
misc.meaningEn: Glory be to Allah, praise be to Allah, there is no god but Allah, and Allah is the greatest.

misc.text: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
misc.meaningEn: There is no power and no strength except with Allah.

misc.text: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ
misc.meaningEn: O Allah, send blessings and peace upon our prophet Muhammad.

tasbih.meaningEn: Glory be to Allah, and praise be to Him.
